standard_name: One Defensible Data Atom Per Programmatic Page

included: Every generated insight page sourced from content/_staged/pages.json or content/_live/pages.json
Every Velocity-owned editorial hub or cluster page sourced from pages.json
All future pages produced by query compilation, signal ingestion, release mutation, or generator scripts

ship_law: A programmatic editorial page without one valid, page-specific, defensible data atom is not admitted to the public release inventory.

allowed_atom_types.original_comparison_table: An original decision-support comparison table with at least three rows and two columns.
allowed_atom_types.dated_primary_stat: A dated original observation with sample size, method, and source URLs.
allowed_atom_types.named_framework: A uniquely named framework with at least three explicit steps.
allowed_atom_types.copy_paste_prompt: A working, page-specific prompt or script with at least three usable lines.
allowed_atom_types.decision_tree: A branching decision tree with at least three condition/action paths.
allowed_atom_types.aggregated_review_synthesis: A dated synthesis with sample size, method, source URLs, and at least three findings.

required_page_contract.direct_answer: A literal answer at the top of the page, 70 words or fewer.

conditional: HowTo when a real procedure or decision sequence is visible
MedicalWebPage for actual medical editorial content
CollectionPage or ItemList for resource collections
prohibited: MedicalClinic for clinics not owned by the publisher

required_page_contract.structure: At least one table or numbered list, normally supplied by the atom.
required_page_contract.internal_links: At least five descriptive links to sibling or cluster pages.
required_page_contract.freshness: dateModified changes only when the source data row changes.
required_page_contract.boilerplate: Generic rewritten filler, duplicated answer bodies, or atoms that do not overlap the page topic are rejected.
required_page_contract.provenance: Regulated and numeric claims must resolve through the source and claim registries with jurisdiction, review date, and recheck date.
required_page_contract.canonical_routing: Every eligible Velocity page routes above the fold, contextually, from decision artifacts where relevant, and at the end of the page to the registered canonical owner.

admission_behavior.new_content: Build fails before publication when a source row lacks a valid atom.
admission_behavior.existing_content: The June 19 migration supplies and validates one source-backed atom for every existing editorial row; output is regenerated from source.
admission_behavior.invalid_content: Invalid rows are excluded from the release inventory or fail the release gate; no silent publication is allowed.
